purpose: Define bounded collections of exact audit, config, certification, test, policy, package, runtime and manual evidence used by a control evaluation.

topics.name: Compliance Evidence Set
topics.purpose: Define bounded collections of exact audit, config, certification, test, policy, package, runtime and manual evidence used by a control evaluation.

semantics.identity_rule: Each evidence set has explicit identity.
semantics.snapshot_rule: Evidence set binds exact revisions/times where relevant.
semantics.integrity_rule: Integrity/hash refs are explicit where required.
semantics.source_rule: Copied evidence does not become new source-of-truth.
semantics.authority_rule: Evidence possession grants no underlying resource authority.

invariants.rule: Policy, decision, evidence, audit record, consent, incident and compliance result remain separate machine-significant identities; no evidence artifact silently becomes source data, authorization or runtime authority.

Ambiguous or unresolved governance for protected data fails closed; UI visibility, transport reachability, cache presence, role title, prior access or audit-log presence never substitute for an explicit valid policy decision.

hard_gates.condition: screenshots treated as sole truth without provenance

references.purpose: Control evaluations consume exact evidence sets.
